capabilities: Sync a chosen vault folder with a YouSpot Brain
Write Brain contacts, companies, projects and links back as Markdown
Resolve conflicts by pushing or pulling individual notes
Export a full Brain selection with attachments
Recover failed uploads and review missing originals
extras: Full Brain export requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ and a backend export adapter; conflicts are never merged automatically. Versions 0.3.0 and earlier stored plaintext tokens in data.json.
problem: Notes, links and tags in a vault folder are not connected to a YouSpot Brain, and Brain objects are not available as Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: Keeps one folder of your vault and your YouSpot Brain in sync, both ways.

summary: Two-way sync between a chosen vault folder and a YouSpot Brain, with conflict handling and full Brain export.
